title: Todos the Physician
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Mishnah Bekhorot 4:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Bekhorot.4.4): an incident of a cow whose womb was removed; Rabbi Tarfon fed it to the dogs, and the case came before the sages (at Yavneh — Gemara), who permitted it. Todos the physician said: “No cow or sow leaves Alexandria without their cutting out its womb.”

In [Nazir 52a](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.52a.6) and [Tosefta Ohalot, chapter 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Oholot.4.2): an incident in which they brought a box full of bones to the synagogue of the Tarsians and set it in an open space; Todos the physician and all the physicians came in and said, “There is no spine of a single corpse here.” The incident is cited in [Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1, folio 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.1.1.34), and there Rabbi Akiva was present.

notes.text: The supplied Berakhot chapter/halakhah/folio is Jerusalem Talmud. The spinal-column statement concerns bones attributed to one corpse, preserving the physicians’ quoted negative. The supplied פ:א is read as chapter1. “In an open space” does not add an unproved assertion that the synagogue was unroofed.

The linked Nazir places the bones in the synagogue of the Tarsians and names Todos. The Tosefta calls the physician Theodoros, gives Lod as the synagogue’s location and mentions both a spine and a skull. The Yerushalmi includes Rabbi Akiva’s response. Hyman’s short account retains the location and wording he gives.
